newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold trade sinks as prices firm.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold trade sinks as prices firm.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange tumbled to 579 kg on Monday from Friday's 1,562 kg as prices increased, squeezing demand, dealers said.
Gold closed firmer at $322.80 an ounce and 1,592,200 lira per gram, compared to $320.30 and 1,563,800 lira on Friday, following firmer levels in European markets.
The Turkish currency closed easier at 153,350 lira to the dollar from around 151,300 lira on Friday.
Most of the day's trade -- 450 kg -- took place in the morning session and 89.8 percent of the total trade was conducted in lira terms.
